item.title: Version 1.7
item.description:
Stability and compatibility

  • Added universal Apple Silicon and Intel support with a project-local libopenmpt build.
  • Fixed shuffle, pause, seek, queue filtering, and stale playback callback behavior.
  • Made library scans cancellable and cache invalidation recursive and format-aware.
  • Made rename, rating, and trash operations report failures without losing files.
  • Extended Quick Look support to every module format recognized by AuDeluxe.

item.title: Version 1.6
item.description:
New Features

  • Added Sparkle for automatic application updates.
  • Implemented a caching system for faster startup times.
  • Added a search bar to the playlist view.
  • Added a jump link for the currently playing song.
  • Added a menu bar to control music without switching to the app.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed an issue where the default sort order was not applied on launch.
  • Loopback worked but the timeline was not moving.
